---
name: Change or addition
about: Something the SDK should do that it does not
labels: enhancement
---

**What you are trying to do**
The surface or workflow, not the mechanism you have in mind.

**What stops you today**
What you tried, and where the contract or the SDK got in the way.

**Does this need a contract change?**
If a document would have to say something new, it belongs in
[get-milano/specs](https://github.com/get-milano/specs) first: mechanics
land there with conformance vectors, then in all three engines together.
If host code alone can do it, it belongs here.
